reading.action: Grab the Gloomward Stalker corpse and drag it back down to the brazier by the water for one last preparation before leaving these rooms behind.
reading.result: NO ROLL (uncontested loot + travel through cleared territory). LOOT TAKEN (explicit grab): Stalker HIDE (light, tough, pale) + Stalker EYE-LENS (clouded crystal that drinks light, cold) — whole carcass hauled down to harvest at base. Returned to the brazier by the water. OBSTACLE he perceives: the brazier is COLD, fuel GONE (spent to the last stick t55) — fire-prep now needs fuel he doesn't have, or fire he makes himself. STATE at the prep station: L5, 3 UNSPENT attribute points, dark/spent Furnace-heart, LOW Burning Anger, Cold Revenge charging in the cistern, the new hide + lens on the pile. COST: Stamina 71->65 (-6 drag); Focus/HP flat. No XP/skill/affinity change. STOP at his decision point — one last preparation, his call what. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
